configuration.title: Your models, your limits.
configuration.provenance: Real bitcode Desktop build with a disposable configuration. No model runs in this walkthrough; the model list comes from the Ollama server running on the recording machine. Input is scripted with Playwright; the pointer is an overlay.

features.title: Every change waits for you.
features.provenance: Real bitcode Desktop build, real local model through Ollama, real bubblewrap worker and a disposable copy of a small demo project. Input is scripted with Playwright; the pointer is an overlay. Model thinking time plays back faster where the badge is shown.

first-run.title: Open it. Pick a local model.
first-run.provenance: Real bitcode Desktop build on its first launch with an empty, disposable configuration. The model list comes from the Ollama server running on the recording machine; the answer comes from that local model. Input is scripted with Playwright; the pointer is an overlay. Model thinking time plays back faster where the badge is shown.
